answer: Deferred activation breaks four ways: not-selected looks like not-installed unless the gateway emits indexed/installed/selected plus activation at failure time (NOT_SELECTED vs INDEX_MISS_INSTALLED on the both-states control); activation can fail mid-task (ACTIVATION_FAILED); deactivate can leave residual state (DEACTIVATED_RESIDUAL); eager stdio MCP multiplies as N*K (K=3 from the fixture, live config K=0, process-table mcp-like=0) which is linear not P1-superlinear. Reviewer added FM-PARTIAL-MATERIALIZE. SUCCESS:ARC-0026

added_failure_mode.description: A capability id can map to a skill file AND a stdio MCP server. The author signal is per-id. Selecting the id and loading the skill sets activation=ok / AVAILABLE while the MCP child was never spawned (or the reverse). FM-SILENT-EQUIV stays green because the id is indexed and selected; FM-PROCESS-MULT stays green because no extra process appeared. Split-plane activation is a third axis.
added_failure_mode.required_followup: Emit the three-bit signal per payload part (skill / hook / mcp), not only per capability id. Do not rebuild A4 DESIGN.json in this unit (that is ARC-0024).

scenario.catching_architecture: A4 gateway with a three-bit availability signal (indexed, installed, selected) plus activation status, emitted at failure time; shared or lazy MCP spawn bounded by a recorded process-count curve that flags P1 only when superlinear.
scenario.on_this_estate: Both-states codes NOT_SELECTED vs INDEX_MISS_INSTALLED. Fixture stdio K=3. Eager curve [3, 6, 12, 24, 48] is linear (superlinear=False). Live process-table mcp-like count=0; live MCP-config stdio per session=0. Estate 23x65=2037 is named and not used as today.
procedure: Build an install tree with skill.alpha on disk and an index that lists it.
Ask the router for a task that does not select skill.alpha; record the three-bit signal (must be NOT_SELECTED).
Remove skill.alpha from the index only; leave the install file; record the signal (must be INDEX_MISS_INSTALLED).
Assert the two codes differ; reject a collapsed unavailable bit that is the same in both states.
Parse live MCP config for stdio server count; enumerate processes via PowerShell or /proc twin; simulate N sessions; flag P1 iff the curve is superlinear.
scenario.title: Index-miss vs not-installed vs not-selected

strongest_surviving_counterargument: A collapsed unavailable bit is what operators already see, and three bits on every miss looks like telemetry bloat. On this Linux worktree A4 DESIGN.json is absent and live MCP config files declare zero stdio servers, so the distinguishing signal and the process curve are proven on fixtures plus catalog-bound A4 activation hops, not on a shipped gateway. That limitation does not make not-selected identical to not-installed, and it does not license citing 23x65=2037 as today's measurement. Strongest surviving FOR: keep the three-bit signal even if spawn later becomes a shared pool; the signal is about discovery, the curve is about spawn policy.
